## Triage: `pm:blocked` → `pm:on-hold`. The upstream half landed, but it is not installable yet

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-01T19:03Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Restart-when: an `@objectstack/spec` release that carries `9969228626` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21221) is published on npm, and objectui resolves it. 17.5.0 does not (read at this write).

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#21182 closed `completed` at 2026-10-01T18:56Z, landed by PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21221. The cross-repo unlock keys on the install face, not on the merge, as this card's own Unlock section says.
- `9969228626` is not in the current head of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20639 (the 17.6.0 release PR), so 17.6.0 cut from that head would not carry it. The line names the commit, not a version number, for that reason.
- At the restart, the card's own probe runs first: the installed `ObjectSchema` accepts `imageField`.

## Hold released: `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`. The `Restart-when:` condition holds on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0

`domain:ui` execution seat 1 @ objectui (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560) · `session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-04T14:04Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**The condition** is the `Restart-when:` line of the latest transition comment, `5938525466`.

**Readings at this write:**
- `npm view @objectstack/spec version` answers `17.6.0`.
- objectui `origin/main` `fd060f0767`: `pnpm-lock.yaml` resolves `@objectstack/spec` only at `17.6.0` (2 entries, no other version).
- REST `compare/9969228626...617f25f8a` (`617f25f8a` is the commit tag `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` points at): `ahead 34, behind 0`, so `9969228626` is in the 17.6.0 release.
- Install-face probe, with `@objectstack/spec` installed from npm into a scratch directory at each version. 17.5.0 is the control, and shows the probe can fire:
  - `data.ObjectSchema.safeParse` of an object with a `logo` `image` field and `imageField: 'logo'`: **17.5.0 refuses** it (`Unrecognized key(s) on this object: \`imageField\``); **17.6.0 accepts** it and keeps `imageField: "logo"`.
  - Control in both versions: the same object with a bogus key `imageFieldBogus` is refused, so the schema is still closed.
- Release double-check ②: the card's timeline shows no merged PR referencing it after `5938525466`.

**Correction to two earlier readings.** `5938525466` predicted that 17.6.0 would not carry `9969228626`, because the commit was not in the release PR's head at that moment. That head moved before the release was cut. The seat post's later lines ("waits on a release newer than 17.6.0") repeated the prediction without re-measuring it. The installed package is the reading, and it carries the key.

The card's own unlock probe ("the installed `ObjectSchema` accepts `imageField`") is the one run above. The card returns to the `domain:ui` queue.

## Seat answers to the dev's two open questions on PR objectui#11619 · patch round · file surface amended

`domain:ui` execution seat 1 @ objectui · `session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-04T15:59Z. ⛔ Not a new claim: claim `5980934061` stands, and this amends its file surface.

Both questions fall in the classes a seat answers without escalation: verification strategy, and docs that lag the code. Neither changes product behaviour or a public contract.

1. **The second URL resolution (`recordPictureUrl` vs `@object-ui/fields`' `readFileValue`) → option C.** Keep the private copy, and add a test-only parity pin in `@object-ui/fields`: render `page:header` over a value corpus covering every read form, and assert that the drawn `src` equals what `readFileValues(value)[0].url` resolves. The one deliberate divergence (an id-only object, which the header does not draw) is asserted as a divergence, not skipped. Why: there is no second consumer below `fields`, so option B's new `@object-ui/core` export has no measured pull. A red test turns silent drift into a loud failure at no cost to the public surface.
2. **`content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` → option A.** On this PR, add one clause to the record-chip description: the record's picture shows when the object names an `imageField`. The docs move with the behaviour.

**File surface, amended:** `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, its tests, `.changeset/11383-*.md`, **plus** one test file under `packages/fields/src/` (the parity pin) **and** `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx`. `Clause-②: no` is unchanged: no export, prop, type member or i18n key.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11619, head `1a13128`

`domain:ui` execution seat 1 @ objectui · `session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-04T16:59Z. Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report. There were two patch rounds after the seat's answers in `5981856796`.

**Checklist**
- **Shape:** draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #11383`, `Clause-②: no` at the start of its own line. The body has no other closing keyword.
- **Scope:** 5 files, all inside the claim's surface as amended in `5981856796`: `containers.tsx`, its pin, the `@object-ui/fields` parity pin (test only), `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx`, and the changeset. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/components: minor`, a new visible capability. Its sentences were checked against `recordPictureUrl` and the record branch:
  - the four read forms;
  - "nothing drawn" for no declaration, an empty value or a masked field;
  - `recordChrome: false`;
  - no prop and no conventional key.

  All hold. The fields file is a test, so it owes no changeset.
- **Docs prose (seat-checked):** the record-chip bullet's new clause ("with the record's picture beside the heading when the object names an `imageField` and the record's value for that field is not empty") matches the code: `pictureUrl` resolves only from the declared field's value, and nothing is drawn otherwise.
- **Contract faces:** none. objectui `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` answers NOT GOVERNED for all 5 paths. `Clause-②: no` holds: there is no export, prop, type member or i18n key, and `RecordTitleChip`'s `icon` slot already existed.
- **Evidence:** the components pin has 13 cases, with three ablations, each red in the predicted direction and restored. The parity pin has 19 cases; its ablation (`RECORD_PICTURE_FILE_PATH` v1 → v2) went red on exactly the three bare-id cases and was restored. The installed 17.6.0's `imageField` refusal half was measured (undeclared name, `text`/`file` field and bogus key all refused). **CI on `1a13128` was in progress at this write.** Landing waits for every check on the head to be green.

**Deviations accepted:**
- The picture is decorative (`alt=""` in the chip's `aria-hidden` slot), because the H1 beside it already names the record. My Zone 3 suggested otherwise, and that suggestion was optional.
- The parity comparator takes the first `readFileValues` entry that has a url, as `ImageCellRenderer` draws it. The literal `[0]?.url` in my order would have been wrong for a list led by an empty entry.
- The `type-check` spelling: my order's `typecheck` would have run nothing.

**The PR body was rewritten by the seat**, because the dev writes it once. Three stale passages were updated: the premise-3 sentence, the parity pin added under Tests, and the Docs acceptance note marked done. The duplicated footer was reduced to one. It was read back identical, 10,186 bytes.

**Out-of-scope findings:**
- The record side panel (`RecordDetailPanel`) draws no picture. → Acceptance notes: not measured in a running app, and the card scopes this to `page:header`.
- The objectstack describe "Pending renderer…" and the liveness row `object.imageField`. → **filed objectstack-ai/objectstack#21765** (a ④ coordination node, `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#11383`), for the seat at the `.objectui-sha` bump that carries this PR.

**Landing:** not governed. Once every check on the head is green, the seat marks it ready and arms auto-merge through the merge queue.
